_comment: Workbook exercise mv-baselines (docs/workbook/mv-baselines.md), part 1b: the same two years as a backcast, a model fitted on 2019 projected back onto 2018, to compare with the forecast. Three cofactor-drammen main meters (ElImp): two schools, b6400 (3,958 m2) and b6404 (6,570 m2), and a nursing home, b6410 (3,327 m2), building categories from the publisher's file headers. Each meter's own outdoor temperature (the oat role stored on the meter) drives a daily change-point + occupied-day model (Monday to Friday except Norway's public holidays, the bundled NO calendar), as in the dataset template; validity 'both' reports the G14 acceptance and the SEP 50001 section 6.4.1 validity side by side. No energy measure is documented in these years, so a saving here is a change nobody has explained.
